entities.name: Ioteba Tamuera Uriam
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Te Ioteba Tamuera Uriam was a politician, writer and musician of Kiribati. He was from Tamana. He wrote the Gilbertese and English lyrics and the music of the national anthem, "Kunan Kiribati".
